name: Kemonomichi -San-
source:
Magic warriors arrive at the village where they agreed to a request for monster extermination.
But there they find another hardship..

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044229.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
魔法战士们来到一个村庄，接受了消灭怪物的委托。
然而在那里，他们遇到了另一重磨难……

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044229.html]DLsite English[/url]）
